title: QoL Revamped
description: This plugin adds QoL (Quality of Life) commands to your server!
body:
This plugin adds QoL (Quality of Life) add-ons to your Minecraft Server.

**= Commands =**
- /gm0 - Sets your gamemode to Survival
- /gm1 - Sets your gamemode to Creative
- /gm2 - Sets your gamemode to Adventure
- /gm3 - Sets your gamemode to Spectator

- /feed - Sets your saturation to the max level
- /heal - Sets your health to the max level

This plugin is in development still and will have some bugs.
Any bugs you find, please let me know on discord.
@lainaid

⚠️ This plugin has only been tested on 1.21.11 Paper, Fabric, Purpur and Spigot servers, not 1.21.8, but it still may work on 1.21+ versions.
